digest.component_or_area: completion verification close gate / LLM agent runaway guard and memoization
propositions: The completion verifier's runaway-guard trips despite the memoization layer because the guard sits outermost and counts memo-served cache hits as loop evidence before the memo layer answers them, causing memo-reduced repeats to still fill the distinct-ratio window.

The runaway guard and memoization layer fight each other: lever 2 (memo banking) made repeats free, but the outermost guard punishes them equally, so re-reads of cached files still trigger RunawayToolLoopError at the distinct-ratio threshold.

A shared ToolCallLedger that tracks only EXECUTED tool calls (misses, not hits) allows the distinct-ratio arm to evaluate loop evidence against actual work, not model chatter, while a served-streak backstop still bounds pure cache-served loops after a full window of zero-execution calls.

Layer composition is reordered so the guard calls record_executed on five execution sites (non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-signature cache miss, read_file first-read whole-file fetch, uncached exact-range fallback, read_file unparseable path) but never on cache-served paths, so memo hits do not increment loop evidence.
